summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle on install
details: native-frontend-orb@1.1.16 declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (rotated string-array of hex/int constants, unicode-name identifiers, string-shuffling routine `WV8StW`), so the code executed on the installer's host is opaque and cannot be reviewed by tooling that only inspects Node-resolved JavaScript. The package's declared purpose per README is a CircleCI orb YAML aggregator, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute a compiled Bun payload. Additional impersonation signals: the package is named `native-frontend-orb` while the declared repository is `ornikar/orb-frontend-native` (words reordered), and the declared `main: index.js` is missing from the tarball, so the package has no library surface beyond the install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
